correctness.rationale: The verifier reconstructs the exact (8,24,17) complex, proves the full complex has no free edge, and replays explicit elementary-collapse sequences for every one of the 17 facet punctures. Each terminal graph is independently checked to be connected and 2-regular. This proves the universal finite claim; the 12/5 terminal-length split is treated only as a feature of the supplied deterministic certificate, not as an invariant.

value.rationale: The minimal dunce hat is a canonical noncollapsible contractible complex. A complete top-facet sensitivity classification is structurally motivated: the unpunctured complex has no legal first collapse, yet removing any single top simplex exposes an explicit collapse to a one-dimensional core. The claim ranges over the entire natural facet layer rather than an arbitrary subset, and the certificates make the boundary behavior reusable in collapsibility and simple-homotopy benchmarks.
